purpose: Independent reproduction, by rebuilding from source, of the upstream fixture-flakiness claim for durable-file-publication branch agent/dfp-pilot-evidence-20261030.
method: git archive of each commit from the upstream repository into a fresh directory; cargo test --lib --no-run --locked --offline through the Mantle worktree wrapper; the resulting lib test executable run 300 times with the default parallel harness (non-zero exit counted as a failure) and once with --test-threads 1.
script_source:
#!/bin/bash
# Independent reproduction of the durable-file-publication fixture-flakiness claim: rebuild the lib tests from source at each commit, then stress-run them.
D=/home/brittonr/.cargo-target/agents-20261030/dfp-pilot
V=/home/brittonr/.cargo-target/agents-20261030/validation/dfp
W=$D/worktree
export PATH=$D/scratch/bin:$PATH      # bwrap symlink the repo's dev shell lacks (same workaround the agent used)
RUNS=300
for pair in orig:99d4281 fixed:fa26782; do
  name=${pair%%:*}; rev=${pair##*:}
  rm -rf $V/$name $V/scratch-$name; mkdir -p $V/$name
  git -C $W archive $rev | tar -x -C $V/$name
  echo "$rev $(git -C $W rev-parse $rev)" > $V/$name.rev
  python3 /home/brittonr/.cargo-target/mantle-complete-20261026-9ar4jfgk/run-in-worktree-v1.py --worktree $V/$name --scratch $V/scratch-$name -- cargo test --lib --no-run --locked --offline > $V/$name.build.log 2>&1
  echo "build-exit=$?" >> $V/$name.build.log
  exe=$(grep -o 'Executable unittests src/lib.rs ([^)]*)' $V/$name.build.log | sed 's/.*(\(.*\))/\1/' | head -1)
  echo "exe=$exe" >> $V/$name.build.log
  [ -x "$exe" ] || { echo "no executable for $name" >> $V/$name.build.log; continue; }
  b3sum --no-names "$exe" > $V/$name.exe.b3
  fail=0; i=0
  while [ $i -lt $RUNS ]; do i=$((i+1)); "$exe" >/dev/null 2>&1 || fail=$((fail+1)); done
  echo "$name rev=$rev runs=$i failures=$fail" | tee $V/$name.stress.txt
  "$exe" --test-threads 1 2>&1 | grep -E '^test result' > $V/$name.serial.txt
done
echo done > $V/DONE
